description: This file defines the CategoryService interface, which declares methods for managing and querying Category entities within an e-commerce system. It includes methods for listing categories by various criteria, retrieving descriptions, adding categories or descriptions, and counting products within categories.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories based on the store and SEO URL.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Gets the description of a category in a specific language.

methods.name: addCategoryDescription
methods.description: Adds a description to a category.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child category to a parent category.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories by parent category.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories by store and parent category.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves categories by store, name, and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories for a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store and code.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists categories by store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a category entity.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories by store and depth.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories by store, depth, and language.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Retrieves categories by store code and lineage string.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a category by store code and category code.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Gets category by store and SEO URL.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists categories by parent category and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a category by ID and language.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of product counts per category.

methods.name: listByCodes
methods.description: Lists categories by store, list of codes, and language.

methods.name: listByIds
methods.description: Lists categories by store, list of IDs, and language.
